blocks.text: Lekin computing ke drawbacks (nuqsan wale pehlu) bhi hain. Ek bari fikr digital divide hai: aabadi ke ek bare hisse ko modern computing technology ka access (pohanch) nahi. Pakistan mein urban-rural (shehri aur dehaati) farq saaf nazar aata hai: dehaati ilaqon mein reliable (bharose wala) internet aur computing devices kam hain, jis se taleem aur naukri ke mauqe barabar nahi rehte. Doosra negative asar misinformation (ghalat maloomat) aur fake news (jhooti khabron) ka phailna hai, jo social unrest (logon mein be-chaini aur jhagre) paida kar sakta hai.

Misal: COVID-19 pandemic (duniya bhar mein phaili bimari) ke dauran virus aur vaccines ke bare mein ghalat maloomat social media par tezi se phaili, aur logon mein uljhan aur khauf paida hua. Is se pata chalta hai ke digital literacy zaroori hai, ta ke log online milne wali maloomat ko soch samajh kar (critically) parakh sakein.

Privacy ki fikr bhi ek bara masla hai, kyunke computing systems ke barhte istemal se bohat sara personal data jama aur store ho raha hai. Sahi regulations (rules aur qanoon) na hon to is data ka ghalat istemal ho sakta hai, aur privacy aur security toot (breach ho) sakti hai. Pakistan mein National Database and Registration Authority (NADRA) se shehriyon ka data leak hone jaise incidents (waaqe) batate hain ke data ki hifazat ke mazboot intezam (data protection measures) kitne zaroori hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Computing technology ki wajah se “Internet in a Box” projects mumkin hue hain jo offline (baghair internet) parhai ka material dete hain. Pakistan mein aise initiatives (programs) ne un remote (bohat door ke) ilaqon tak digital taleem pohanchai hai jahan internet nahi, aur yeh dikhaya hai ke technology peeche reh jane wale (underserved) ilaqon mein taleem ka faasla kam kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Aam log ghalat maloomat ka nuqsan kaise kam kar sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kisi baat ko maanne ya share karne se pehle use reliable (bharose wale) sources se check karein (critical thinking aur digital literacy), aur unverified (jin ki sachai check nahi hui) messages aage forward na karein.

items: Negative asar: digital divide (shehri-dehaati farq), misinformation aur fake news (COVID-19), privacy ke khatre (NADRA data leak).
“Internet in a Box”: baghair internet ke ilaqon mein offline digital taleem.
